title: He asked Santa for a poorly designed toy, to redesign it. He was seven or eight.
caption:
He asked Santa for a poorly designed toy, to redesign it. He was seven or eight.

Short on rent, he blew up three air mattresses at $80 a night. Five investors said no. Two never replied.

He hot-glued Obama O's cereal boxes to dig out of debt. In 2016, Obama himself asked what Airbnb was worth.

In 2020 he laid off nearly 1,900 people, almost in tears. Seven months later, Airbnb went public.

That kid is Brian Chesky. Forbes says he's worth $11.9 billion.

What did you take apart as a kid?
